retrievalProfile.description: A sophisticated 1970s studio portrait featuring a subject on a velvet chaise longue against a backdrop of horizontal venetian blinds with elegant serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A glamorous indoor studio composition centered on a seated figure in a white lace top and black velvet trousers, reclining on a deep burgundy velvet sofa. The background consists of dark horizontal blinds creating a rhythmic linear pattern, while the lighting emphasizes the textures of lace, velvet, and hair. Typography is flush-right, utilizing a mix of high-contrast serif and script.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a linear geometric background
High-contrast texture pairing of delicate lace and heavy velvet
Deep burgundy and black tones contrasted by bright white lace
Right-aligned typographic block balancing the subject's leftward lean
coreInvariants: Deep red or burgundy velvet furniture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical frame, seated on a large chaise longue.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The deep burgundy velvet sofa provides a heavy, stable base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the lace sleeve down to the sofa, and then moves to the top-right typographic block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant provides breathing room for the text against the rhythmic blinds.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep burgundy and black (sofa and trousers)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and gold jewelry
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the white lace and dark background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif and elegant formal script
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses extreme stroke contrast (thick verticals, hairline horizontals)
Script text uses a fluid, slanted cursive with connected glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast bold serif for the name paired with a delicate, lowercase script for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast vertical strokes and elegant serifs of the display text.
Captures the fluid, formal script quality of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a person with voluminous dark hair wearing a white lace blouse and black trousers, reclining on a deep burgundy velvet chaise longue. The background is a dark wall with horizontal venetian blinds. Lighting is soft but directional, highlighting the lace texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of right-aligned uppercase text in a bold Didot-style font in the top right corner. Below it, add a single line of lowercase script text in a pale cream color.

verificationChecks: Does the background feature horizontal blinds?
Is the sofa a deep burgundy velvet?
Is the display font a high-contrast serif?

adjustableVariables: Sofa color (e.g., emerald green, navy blue)
postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of horizontal blind patterns
Ensure the velvet looks plush and heavy
Confirm the lace has visible transparency
Check that the text does not overlap the subject's head
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Velvet Furniture + Venetian Blinds + High-Contrast Serif Typography
